When: Tue 2:00-2:45 PM
Where: Board Room, Silverforge Foundation
Description: Since we apparently still can't agree on finalists after three email threads, let's sort this out in person. Chidi, Sana, Elena, Kemi, Goran, Dmitri - please bring your rankings and be ready to actually decide. -Omar"},{"spec_id":"spec_0768","text":"All-staff, 30 min: sorry for short notice - Quill 2.0 layoffs Q&A. -Sam"},{"spec_id":"spec_0769","text":"Good afternoon, all.

I would like to schedule a session for Wednesday from 10:00 to 10:45 in the site trailer at the east yard, with a dial-in available for those off site. Invited: @Valentina Dorsey, @Sam Fitzgerald, @Vera Nwachukwu, @Rhys Gallo, @Jonas Yamamoto, @Will Ferraro.

As you are aware, we have now closed out the Grummond contract. Before the team disperses to the next phase of work, I believe it is important that we sit down together while the experience remains fresh. Several of you have raised points with me individually over recent weeks, and I would prefer that those conversations happen with everyone present rather than through me.

I would ask each of you to come prepared to speak candidly. Please bring any notes, photographs, daily logs, or correspondence you feel are relevant. Valentina, if you are able to bring the revised schedule history, that would be helpful. Rhys and Jonas, your field perspective will be particularly valuable, and Will, please bring the subcontractor records.

This will be a working session. I do not intend to present slides, and I would ask that we keep phones aside for the duration. Our aim is to leave with a shared and agreed understanding that the whole group can stand behind, and that we can carry into the next bid.

Please confirm your availability in this thread by end of day Monday. If Wednesday morning presents a conflict with a pour or inspection, let me know and I will look at Thursday instead.

Regards,
Nils
Project Manager, Kowalczyk Construction"},{"spec_id":"spec_0770","text":"GLENBROOK FREIGHT - Project Heron Talent Pipeline Sync
